method: Three samples per case, 100 ms each. Graph includes parity tests for both symbol sets and selected/unselected matches. Editor operation is one Up/Down pair; setup excluded. Synthetic fixtures, no live UI latency measurements.
limits: Synthetic Go benchmarks; not live UI or end-to-end latency measurements.
Three short samples per timed case; suitable for ranking, not for choosing production scheduling thresholds.
Graph timing uses box symbols, a fixed 500-commit generated fixture and a viewport beginning at commit 100.
Graph output parity covers both symbol sets and selected/unselected matches; the sequential alternative is only a disposable probe.
CPU-frequency and scheduling differences can affect cross-case comparisons.
Editor measures an Up/Down pair over already prepared unwrapped cells, excluding rendering and callbacks.
Occupancy counts measure an adversarial wide row and octopus merge; they do not establish the frequency or CPU share of those shapes in real repositories.
